##### Project general facts

Rosalia Residence is a contemporary residential development where elegant architecture and modern design blend seamlessly with the surrounding natural landscape. Defined by clean lines, expansive glazing, and thoughtfully designed living spaces, the project creates an atmosphere of comfort, sophistication, and connection. Ideally located within a vibrant neighborhood, Rosalia Residence offers residents effortless access to golf clubs, shopping destinations, fine dining, entertainment venues, and everyday conveniences, delivering a lifestyle that perfectly balances tranquility with urban energy.

Residents enjoy a welcoming community designed to enhance everyday living through beautifully landscaped surroundings and thoughtfully planned amenities. Spacious residences filled with natural light create a peaceful retreat, while the development’s excellent connectivity ensures that Dubai’s key destinations are always within easy reach. Rosalia Residence is designed for those who value comfort, convenience, and a refined contemporary lifestyle.

The residences feature modern interiors finished with high-quality materials, emphasizing spacious layouts, abundant natural light, and elegant detailing throughout the living areas, bedrooms, and bathrooms. Kitchens are fully equipped with premium appliances and contemporary finishes, combining style with everyday functionality. The residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to create interiors that reflect their own personal taste and lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
